basis: Shared RTX A6000 GPU3 on node3002, batch5; 4-epoch fit plus four measured batches per probe condition after two warmups. Bounds are planning ranges, not confidence intervals; no exclusive RTX4090 timing yet.
range_rules: Train/inference min and max probe batch times with 10% margin; cached loading 0.5x to 2x; checkpoint updates 1 to 100 (center 50). Clinical-only adds estimated 0.5ms host cost per batch; 0.5x to 3x compute range.
